text:
alex kim: Quick thread — I'm landing a migration note for Dedicated capacity. Changes: SDK call rename, Terraform module move, autoscale examples.

sara li: FYI the terraform link points to `modules/dedicated` which is now `modules/infra/dedicated-capacity`. Docs link needs update.

ben thompson: Updated Python snippet below; switching from `create_dedicated` -> `create_capacity` and adding a short-burst example.
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
cap = c.create_capacity(name="corp-team", gpu_pool="a100-40gb", min_instances=1, max_instances=8,
                        autoscale_policy={"target_rps":100, "burst_window_seconds":60, "burst_capacity":30})
print(cap.id)
```

devex-amy: Added migration checklist item: reconcile alerting hooks (eviction/host-move) -> ensure SRE runbooks referenced. Also note to run `make docs-linkcheck` locally.

morgan: Re SLA language: current phrasing "full isolation" is misleading. Propose: "Dedicated provides tenant-level compute and network isolation; in rare planned or emergency maintenance events, hosts (or GPUs) may be migrated or reclaimed per our maintenance policy. Redwood will notify customers and trigger configured fallback models." Short and clear.

alex kim: Nice. I'll swap the paragraph and add a 1-paragraph note on eviction signals + link to eng-oncall runbook (`/s/eng-oncall/eviction-runbook`).

sara li: Can we include a terse terraform example showing module source update? e.g.
```hcl
module "dedicated" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/infra//modules/dedicated-capacity"
  name   = "team-prod"
}
```

ben thompson: Also added a JS snippet variant for the SDK rename in a separate commit.

docs-bot: link-checker: scanned 37 links, 1 broken -> docs/terraform/dedicated, suggested replacement docs/terraform/infra/dedicated-capacity.

alex kim: Thanks, pushing the fixes now. Reviewer checklist: run snippets locally, confirm terraform path, approve only after docs-bot green.

deploy-bot: PR #1302 pushed by alex kim — link-check queued.
